evidence.quote: If you select a price class that does not include all locations, some of your viewers, especially those in geographic locations that are not in your price class, may experience higher latency than if your content were being served from all Amazon CloudFront locations.
When this occurs, you will only be charged the rates for the least expensive location in your price class.
Note that Amazon CloudFront may still occasionally serve requests for your content from an edge location in a location that is not included in your price class.
